question.prompt: Which alerts are expected to show a dismiss control?

options.label: Only marked alerts
options.detail: Require a dismiss control only for alerts the product explicitly marks or presents as dismissible.

options.label: All alerts
options.detail: Require every alert in the list to show a dismiss control.

options.label: Need source
options.detail: Add a source that names which alert types are dismissible.

content.risk_rationale: Dismissibility affects whether the owner can action or clear alerts, but the source phrase "where applicable" never defines the applicable subset, so any stricter oracle would be guessed.
